title: E5 离散规则监测计算实验
research_goal: 验证既定离散观测规则的计算一致性、有限前缀判定和边界/变形稳健性。
reference_method: Independent Decimal enumeration: per trigger search all supplied future observations; never import the FIFO implementation as oracle.
primary_comparison: Compare verdict, violation indices, trigger indices, recovered/expired/pending obligation IDs for every case and each eligible prefix.
expected_properties: closed deadline plus explicitly declared timestamp epsilon
time translations and joint value/threshold translations preserve Decimal results
neutral resampling is checked only with preserved trigger/recovery endpoints
accepted future continuations cannot change already consumed transition events
failure_policy: Persist disagreements and input-rejection differences; do not rewrite expected semantics or production monitor to force pass.
exact_vs_operational_timing: Additionally evaluate epsilon=0 to reveal the declared 1e-9 operational tolerance widening a strict mathematical deadline.
